requirements.text: Have 3+ years experience working across the stack within large, well-maintained codebases.
Have experience building product features in complex technical domains; experience with applied AI, prompting systems, evaluation/testing infrastructure, or agent-style workflows is a plus.

Have a track record of working with your team to scope and deliver impactful features.
Are able to bring structure, judgment, and collaboration to evolving AI/product challenges.
Enjoy working in a highly cross-functional environment with product, design, and other engineering partners.
Engage with your colleagues in a spirit of openness and curiosity.
Find AI fascinating and are excited about its potential to improve how people work.
Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across functions.
Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

Asana is seeking an experienced and empathetic Software Engineer to join our AI Teammates Experience team. Asana’s AI Teammates are fundamentally changing the way teams collaborate in and outside of Asana by giving teams access to AI agents that can take on tasks and collaboratively work with human colleagues to complete them. You’ll be building engaging experiences that enable our customers to work effectively with their AI Teammates. You’ll build the interaction and product surfaces for teams, users, and admins, working closely with foundation teams on prompting systems, evaluation/testing infrastructure, and agent capabilities. We’re looking for an engineer who is passionate about AI, curious to learn about everything from how people interact with agents to prompt engineering.
